The appearance of yellow streaks (pre-pustules), followed by small, bright yellow, elongated uredial pustules arranged in conspicuous rows on the leaves, leaf sheaths and glumes.
Circular or oval, orange pustules on the upper surface of infected leaves.
Pustules are more scattered and larger in size compared to yellow rust.
Uredinia are orange to dark red in colour and form on both surfaces of leaves.
They are elliptical to elongate and are larger than those of leaf and yellow rusts.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
U (unlikely to have acute toxicity with normal use).
